name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
summary: Far Seer Mok'thardin continues assembling the components for a potent shamanistic item to aid the Horde. After working with feline trophies, he turns his attention toward the feathers worn by the raptors of Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Feathers of the Stalker
sections.body: Following the recovery of materials from the jungle's feline predators, Far Seer Mok'thardin reveals that more components are needed before his shamanistic ritual can begin. To forge a tool fit to assist the Warchief, he requires feathers worn by Jungle Stalkers. These raptors inhabit the dense jungle south of Grom'gol Base Camp, not far from the great arena.

faq.q: Who is asking for the feathers?
faq.answer: Far Seer Mok'thardin, an orc shaman stationed at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale, seeks the feathers to complete a ritual enchantment.

faq.q: Where are the Jungle Stalkers located?
faq.answer: A tribe of these raptors can be found living directly south of Grom'gol Base Camp, in the jungle near the Gurubashi Arena.

faq.q: Why does Far Seer Mok'thardin need Jungle Stalker feathers?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin is combining various jungle curiosities and beast trophies through a shamanistic ritual to create an enchanted tool intended to assist the Horde and the Warchief.
Adventurers previously aided Mok'thardin by hunting the feline beasts of the Vale to gather the initial components for his planned enchantment.

angles.text: Far Seer Mok'thardin intends for the finished enchantment to be a useful tool for the Horde and the Warchief.
The Far Seer combines jungle trinkets with his shamanistic ritual to make an enchanted item.
